chunks: The people of Noah accused the apostles of lies.
ai.seo_question: Who did the people of Noah accuse of lying?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the pattern of 'kudhb' (denial) by the elite against divine messengers, serving as a precursor to the ultimate victory of the righteous. It connects the historical narrative of Noah to the broader theological concept of *al-Ghuluw* (exaggeration) in belief, where the masses often rejected the core message of monotheism. The verse thus reinforces the Shia emphasis on enduring patience (*sabr*) amidst societal rejection of truth.
